lines: Still here. They have stopped bringing me tea, which I think is a hint.
Go and beat Roxen. She is a nightmare and you will feel wonderful afterwards.
And keep that thing in your bag. Not hidden. Just... in your bag.
Eleven pieces. Eleven, in the whole region, and none of them match.
Either the Aurelians made eleven things, or somebody has the rest of them.
Sorry. You wanted to look at the case and I am standing in front of it.
I have been standing in front of it for two days.
The staff have started bringing me tea. I think they have given up on me.
Lyra. I catalogue things for the Meridian Foundation.
Which mostly means I look at something very old and write down,
in a very neat hand, that nobody knows what it is.
Something in your bag turns over, once, and goes warm.
That. In your bag. May I -
No. Sorry. That was extremely rude and I am going to sit down.
It has the same marks as the disc. Circles inside circles,
and the spiral running out of the middle of them.
That is not a pattern people invented twice.
Where did you get it? - no. Don't answer that either.
People go strange about the things their families leave them,
and I have watched enough of them regret telling me.
It has been somewhere, hasn't it. It is warmer than the case.
There is an arch in the forest on Route 2 with those marks on it.
I could not get it to do anything at all. Two days I tried.
Here. Take this before you go down the Hall's mine.
The workings are wet and the lamps they lend you are worse than they say.
Lyra handed over 2 Escape Lines.
And - look. I write things down for a living, and I write down
everything I see. I am not going to write this one down.
I would rather find out what it is before anybody else does.
The young woman at the Aurelian case has been here nine days.
She has better manners than most of my trustees and she pays for her own tea.
I have stopped asking who sent her. It seemed impolite.
Welcome. Forty kinds of rock, six thousand years of people,
and one case at the far end that I cannot explain to schoolchildren.
Start at the rock. Everyone runs to the far end. Start at the rock.
